text: AI agents can now trade your money.
But one clever prompt can trick an agent into draining the wallet.
Vyoo moves the rules out of the prompt, and into the contract.
Every trade must pass seven on-chain rings. Spend cap. Allowlist. Oracle band. Slippage. Daily loss. K Y C tier. And cooldown.
The A I can be fooled. The contract can't.
Honest trades pass, swap on HashKey Chain, and leave an on-chain receipt.
In the Arena, anyone can try to break it. Fool the A I, win a bounty. Beat the contract, take the pot.
